notes: The opening but answers to no conjunction morpheme and is added, while the first ʿad is left unstated; the competing reading gives but to that ʿad, which a preposition cannot carry (rules 14, 40).
ʿad ʾăšer, bə-qereb, lipnê and lāmmâ are each single-word fusions (rule 30), and the emphatic zeh goes unrepresented.
The lə of hāyāh lə keeps nothing once the clause is recast with the predicate adjective loathsome (rule 21).
